entities.summary: West Indies Federation, a political institution in Barbados during Labour Movement and Path to Self-Governance (1946–1965). Grew from Grantley Adams founds Barbados Labour Party 1938 and 1937 Riots and Labour Awakening. Led to the emergence of Grantley Adams and Grantley Adams becomes Prime Minister of West Indies Federation 1958.
